DiscoveryRun.title: DiscoveryRun
DiscoveryRun.description: One reproducible discovery run with a content-addressed id and digest-chained lineage (verified end-to-end by verifyDiscoveryRun).

CapabilityDiscoveryRecordVersion.title: CapabilityDiscoveryRecordVersion
CapabilityDiscoveryRecordVersion.description: Version discriminator carried by every serialized discovery record (currently 1).

DiscoveryRunId.title: DiscoveryRunId
DiscoveryRunId.description: Content-addressed discovery run id: "discrun:" + 16 hex characters.

DiscoveryRunKind.title: DiscoveryRunKind
DiscoveryRunKind.description: Discovery run kind: problem-driven (stream A) or ecosystem (stream B).

DiscoveryTenantId.title: DiscoveryTenantId
DiscoveryTenantId.description: Tenant identifier: "tenant:" + lowercase slug (the W009 grammar, mirrored).

DiscoveryCompilerVersion.title: DiscoveryCompilerVersion
DiscoveryCompilerVersion.description: Version of the universal demand compiler + role synthesizer.

CapabilityDiscoveryContractVersion.title: CapabilityDiscoveryContractVersion
CapabilityDiscoveryContractVersion.description: Version of the published capability-discovery contract surface.

DiscoveryRunTrigger.title: DiscoveryRunTrigger
DiscoveryRunTrigger.description: The trigger record on a run (manual, gap, scheduled, or event).

DiscoveryTrigger.title: DiscoveryTrigger
DiscoveryTrigger.description: What triggered a discovery run: manual, gap, scheduled, or event.

DiscoveryStageLink.title: DiscoveryStageLink
DiscoveryStageLink.description: One link of a run's digest chain: stage name, stage digest, previous stage digest.

DiscoveryStageName.title: DiscoveryStageName
DiscoveryStageName.description: Lineage stage name: inputs, demands, roles, resolution, organizations, evaluation, selection, candidates, gap-updates, promotions.

DiscoveryTimestamp.title: DiscoveryTimestamp
DiscoveryTimestamp.description: UTC instant in canonical form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ (caller-supplied; never wall-clock).
